changelog:
🚀 New Features & Enhancements
• Cloudflare CI/CD Root Configuration: Added root `wrangler.toml` pointing to `cloudflare-worker/worker.js` with R2 bindings for automated builds.
• Cloudflare R2 Pull-Through Worker Cache: High-performance edge cache for email template images with jsDelivr origin fallback and automatic TTL pruning.
